title: Antique Brass Cabinet Pull 3.9-Inch Solid Brass Cabinet Mount, Cabinet Hardware Collection, Allied Brass
description:
Make cabinets and drawers easier to open while updating the look of your space with this cabinet pull in Antique Brass, which features a softened, aged golden patina that brings vintage charm and character to traditional spaces. This cabinet pull (also called a cabinet handle or drawer pull) is part of a coordinated cabinet hardware collection with a distinctive, transitional style that fits both kitchen and bathroom projects, including transitional bathroom hardware and other versatile bath accessories.

Highlights:
- Antique Brass brings warm, timeless elegance
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your space
- Straightforward install: cabinet mount / cabinet-mounted hardware with all mounting hardware included
- Finish flexibility for matching your room: available in multiple designer finish options
- Designed for corrosion-free and rust-free performance

- Product type: Cabinet pull / cabinet handle / drawer pull
- Material: Brass (solid brass)
- Mounting: Cabinet mount; cabinet-mounted (wall hanging not applicable)
- Dimensions (L x H x W): 3.9 in x 1.6 in x 0.9 in
- Projection: 1 in
- Weight capacity: 2 lb
- Product weight: 0.8 lb
- Included items: Cabinet pull and all installation hardware
- Assembly required: No
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
- Assembled in the USA
